# React SCSS Template llms.txt
# https://YOUR.DOMAIN

## About
React SCSS Template is a clean-architecture starter for React single-page apps:
React 19, TypeScript (strict), Vite, pnpm, react-router, zustand, SCSS Modules,
and PWA support, with native Node tests and Cloudflare Pages CI.

## When to Use This
- **Starting a new React project**: clone the GitHub template at
  https://github.com/subhro-kar/react-template-scss and run `pnpm install`.
- **Understanding the layering**: read AGENTS.md (dependency rule) and the
  per-layer READMEs under src/domain, src/application, src/infrastructure,
  and src/presentation.
- **Running or verifying the app**: `pnpm dev`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm lint`,
  `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm build` (Node 22.18+, pnpm 11.19+).
- **Adding a feature**: follow the new-feature checklist in
  src/presentation/README.md — domain rules, ports, zustand store factory,
  adapters, lazy route behind a VITE_ENABLE_* flag.

## Key Pages
- / — Home
- /tasks — Example feature (only when VITE_ENABLE_TASKS=true)

## Repository Layout
- src/domain — pure entities and business rules; no React or DOM imports
- src/application — ports, zustand store factories, feature flags
- src/infrastructure — adapters: localStorage, HTTP, ids, clock
- src/presentation — components, SCSS Modules, routes
- src/main.tsx — composition root where adapters and stores are wired
- scripts/ — PWA icon and Open Graph image generation
- .github/workflows — CI (verify) and Cloudflare Pages deploy

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: React 19, react-router 7, zustand 5
- Build: Vite 8, TypeScript 7 (strict), Sass, vite-plugin-pwa
- Tooling: Biome (lint + format), lefthook (git hooks), native Node test
  runner with c8 coverage
- Package manager: pnpm 11 (allowBuilds policy blocks lifecycle scripts)

## Conventions
- Conventional Commits on main; Biome formatting enforced by pre-commit hook
- Feature flags default to false and gate both route and nav link
- SCSS Modules colocated with components; design tokens in
  src/presentation/styles/global.scss (light + dark)
